articles.title: Trump "not satisfied" with new peace deal offered by Iran as standoff's costs multiply
articles.summary: Iran proposed new talks with the US to end the war. The standoff's costs are increasing. Live Updates: Iran offers new proposal for talks with U. S. to end war as standoff's costs multiply CBS News.

articles.title: After Canada loosens citizenship requirements, thousands of people apply
articles.summary: A Canadian law change has opened citizenship opportunities, attracting thousands of Americans who are applying for Canadian citizenship for political and personal reasons. Many are motivated by a desire to escape US politics and policies.

articles.title: A deadline for the Iran war is here. What does the War Powers Act say?

articles.title: Trump says will raise US tariffs on EU cars to 25%
articles.summary: US tariffs on EU cars and trucks will rise to 25 per cent from next week, US President Trump announced, accusing the European Union of not following a previous trade deal. The increase will take effect on 12 April 2026.

articles.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
articles.summary: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

articles.title: Trump says 'not satisfied' with new Iran proposal sent through Pakistan
articles.summary: The US administration has declared its war in Iran terminated, 60 days before a deadline to seek congressional approval. The decision comes after a ceasefire was brokered in the region.

articles.title: US judge bars Trump from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals
articles.summary: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals, part of a broader immigration crackdown. The administration had sought to cancel temporary protections for 13 countries.

articles.title: The Risk That Could Break Banks
articles.summary: Gas prices rose to $4.39 per gallon in a single day. Geopolitics: The Risk That Could Break Banks Forbes.

articles.title: U.S. Indictment of Sinaloa’s Governor Is a Reckoning for Residents of the Mexican State
articles.summary: The US indicted Sinaloa's governor for organized crime ties. The U. S. indictment of a Mexican governor confirms what many residents say they had long suspected: The line between organized crime and the upper echelons of government has blurred.

articles.title: Israel Said to Have Helped Defend Emirates in Iran War With Iron Dome
articles.summary: Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE with its Iron Dome missile defense system during the Iran war. The Emirates bore the brunt of Iran's retaliatory attacks on Gulf countries. It appeared to be the first time the missile defense system was sent to an Arab country.

articles.title: Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced

articles.title: Turkish police fire tear gas, arrest hundreds at Istanbul May Day rallies

articles.summary: China wants the UN to revisit its Lebanon peacekeeping mission decision. China Says UN Should Revisit Lebanon Peacekeeping Mission Decision U. S. News & World Report.

articles.title: In Packed Cafes, Iranians Yearn to Escape War’s Wreckage
articles.summary: Iranians gather in cafes to discuss hopes and fears. Cafes and coffee shops give Iranians affordable places to talk about their hopes, fears and the cost of living as well as to seek company in uncertain times.
